skills.name: The number i
skills.wrong_turn: i² is −1, not 1, and i itself is not −1. Only its square is.
skills.rule: i2=−1, and powers of i cycle: i,−1,−i,1.

skills.name: Square roots of negatives
skills.wrong_turn: √−4 · √−9 is not √36 = 6. Change to i first: 2i · 3i = −6.

skills.name: Standard form a + bi
skills.wrong_turn: The imaginary part of 3 − 5i is −5, not −5i. The part is a real number; i just labels it.
skills.rule: A complex number is a+bi with real part a and imaginary part b, both real.

skills.name: Multiply complex
skills.wrong_turn: (2 + 3i)(1 − 4i) is not 2 − 12i. Every term multiplies every term, and −12i² becomes +12.

skills.name: Conjugates
skills.wrong_turn: The conjugate of 3 + 2i is 3 − 2i, not −3 − 2i. Only the imaginary part changes sign.
skills.rule: The conjugate of z=a+bi is z¯=a−bi, and zz¯=a2+b2.

skills.name: Divide complex
skills.wrong_turn: Don't divide parts separately: (3 + 4i)/(1 − 2i) is not 3 − 2i. Multiply by the conjugate.

skills.name: Complex plane
skills.wrong_turn: 3i is plotted at (0, 3), on the vertical axis, not at (3, 0) on the real axis.
skills.rule: a+bi is plotted at the point (a,b): real axis across, imaginary axis up.

skills.name: Modulus
skills.wrong_turn: |3 + 4i| is √(9 + 16) = 5, not 3 + 4 = 7. Don't include i: it's √(a² + b²).

skills.name: Complex roots of quadratics
skills.wrong_turn: A negative discriminant doesn't mean "no solution" in complex numbers: x² + 4 = 0 has x = ±2i.
skills.rule: If b2−4ac<0, the roots are (−b±i4ac−b22a), a conjugate pair.

skills.name: Fundamental theorem of algebra
skills.wrong_turn: Degree n means at most n distinct roots. x² − 2x + 1 = (x − 1)² has one root, 1, counted twice.
skills.rule: A polynomial of degree n≥1 has exactly n complex roots, counted with multiplicity.

skills.name: Polar form
skills.wrong_turn: Check the quadrant: for −1 − i, arctan(1) gives 45°, but the angle is 225°.

skills.name: Multiply & divide in polar
skills.wrong_turn: When multiplying in polar form, add the angles; don't multiply them. 30° times 60° isn't 1800°.
skills.rule: Multiply moduli and add arguments: r1eiα⋅r2eiβ=r1r2ei(α+β).

skills.name: De Moivre's theorem

steps.d: use De Moivre to find cos 2θ, sin 2θ, cos 3θ or sin 3θ

skills.wrong_turn: (1 + i)² is not 1 + i² = 0. Use polar form or FOIL: it's 2i.

skills.name: Roots of complex numbers
skills.wrong_turn: A nonzero number has n different nth roots, not one. Cube roots of 8 include −1 ± √3 i, not just 2.
skills.rule: zn=reiθ has n roots rnei(θ+2πk)/n for k=0,1,…,n−1.

skills.name: Complex loci

steps.c: arg(z − a) = θ is a half-line

skills.wrong_turn: Flip the sign to read the center. |z+2i|=3 is |z−(−2i)|=3: a circle centered at −2i, not 2i.
